page.content:
Living dinosaurs — the surviving theropod lineage.

How Birds connects

  • Topic: Theropoda — Living birds are nested inside Theropoda.
  • Item: Archaeopteryx — Archaeopteryx is the first well-known stem bird.
  • Event: K–Pg extinction — Avian dinosaurs survived the K–Pg event that killed the rest.
  • Item: Velociraptor — Velociraptor's feathers and wrists sit close to the bird line among maniraptorans.

What is Birds?

Modern birds are nested theropod dinosaurs, a result built from Archaeopteryx, Chinese feathered fossils, and the shared wrists, wishbones, and hollow bones of maniraptorans.

Key threads lead to Theropoda, Archaeopteryx, K–Pg extinction and Velociraptor.
